page.bio: I am Youssef Alaa, an independent software developer and interface craftsman. I specialize in building cross-platform mobile applications with Flutter and high-performance web systems with Next.js. My focus is combining deep architectural rigor with fluid, tactile interactions that make applications memorable.

philosophy.title: End-to-End Ownership
philosophy.description: From blank canvas to App Store approval, I manage design systems, state architecture, database schemas, and release pipelines.

philosophy.title: Frictionless Fluidity
philosophy.description: Applications must feel weightless. I obsess over 60fps animations, instant input feedback, and crisp layout rhythm.

philosophy.title: Resilient Clean Code
philosophy.description: Readable, strongly typed, modular codebases designed to scale seamlessly without technical debt.

timeline.description: Architected a real-time Kitchen Display System for an MPOS environment, built a native Kotlin receipt-printing bridge, and shipped a delivery driver app with GPS tracking and biometric shift verification.
Built scalable Flutter applications on Clean Architecture and SOLID principles, integrating REST APIs and third-party SDKs with CI/CD-driven deployments.
Delivered core features for an AI-powered marketplace, including real-time chat, push notifications and deep REST API integration for live trading flows.
Mentored students in Flutter development — architecture, state management and deployment — as part of Google's official code-instructor programme.

page.ctaSub: Let's collaborate on your next mobile app or web platform.

heading: Selected Work
work.intro: Nineteen products, shipped end to end — fintech to fleet tracking, e-commerce to education, mobile and web alike.

bablabab.title: Bablabab
bablabab.summary: A door-to-door e-commerce mobile application built with Flutter and Firebase.
bablabab.overview: Bablabab is a door-to-door marketplace built for everyday errands — browsing, ordering and delivery live in one Flutter app, backed by Firebase for auth, catalogue data and order state.
features: Cart, checkout and order tracking in one flow
Push notifications for order status updates
capabilities: Real-time order and delivery status sync
Role-aware flows for customers and drivers
Offline-tolerant cart and checkout state

bella.title: Bella
bella.summary: Modern e-commerce platform with a seamless shopping experience across web and mobile.
bella.overview: Bella brings a boutique's catalogue online with a shopping experience that stays consistent from the storefront to checkout, built with Flutter and backed by Firebase for products, orders and accounts.
features: Browsable catalogue with categories and search
Cart and a streamlined checkout flow
capabilities: Consistent shopping experience across every screen
Firestore-backed product and order data
Built for iterative catalogue and promotion updates

kidzoo.title: Kidzoo
kidzoo.summary: Interactive educational platform for children with a gamified learning experience.
kidzoo.overview: Kidzoo turns early learning into a game — matching, sound and colour built with Flutter Flame so animals, letters and numbers stay playful, with Flutter TTS so every prompt is heard as well as seen.
features: Bright, child-safe UI with large touch targets
Progress and score tracking per session
capabilities: Age-appropriate content pacing by role
Offline-friendly gameplay for uninterrupted sessions
Sound design tuned for a young audience

montazah.title: Montazah
montazah.summary: An app for a venue and cafe space offering a relaxing lounge experience, built with Flutter.
montazah.overview: Montazah is the booking companion for a venue-and-café space — a calm, Flutter-built app that turns finding a table or reserving a lounge session into a couple of taps.
features: Space and session browsing with availability
Venue details, hours and lounge information
capabilities: Built for fast, low-friction reservations
Consistent visual language across every screen
Designed to scale to more venues and sessions

services27.title: 27Services
services27.summary: A multilingual services and grocery ordering app, built with Flutter and Firebase.
services27.overview: 27Services pairs a general services marketplace with grocery ordering in one Flutter app — Firebase auth, Firestore data and Google Maps location, delivered in a fully multilingual interface with its own admin dashboard.
features: Multilingual UI for a broader audience
capabilities: Firestore-backed catalogue and request data
A dedicated admin dashboard for operations
Two product lines running from one codebase

hessah.title: Hessah
hessah.summary: An education platform connecting instructors and students, built with Flutter and Firebase.
hessah.overview: Hessah connects instructors and students around real courses — built with Flutter and Firebase so teaching, enrolling and tracking progress all live in a single, focused app.
capabilities: Separate instructor and student experiences
Cloud-synced course and progress data
Built to scale to more instructors and cohorts

hola.title: Hola Academy
hola.summary: A swimming academy app for booking and managing sessions, built with Flutter and Firebase.
hola.overview: Hola Academy is the booking and management app for a swimming club — trainees check in with QR codes, coaches track sessions, and admins run the whole club, all from one Flutter and Firebase app.
features: Push notifications for reminders and updates
Role-based views for trainee, coach and admin
capabilities: Firebase-backed roles, ratings and analytics
Real-time schedule and attendance data
Built to run a full club's day-to-day operations

ogg.title: OGG Tech
ogg.summary: A modern tech company website, built with Next.js and deployed live.
ogg.overview: A modern marketing site for a tech company, built with Next.js and shipped live — fast, accessible pages that introduce the company and its work without any of the usual template feel.
capabilities: Server-rendered pages for strong load performance
Built for easy content and section updates
Clean, modern visual identity

purefit.title: PureFit
purefit.summary: A fitness app with Gemini AI-powered personalised coaching and step tracking.
purefit.overview: PureFit turns a Gemini AI model into a personal coach — personalised workout plans, step tracking and offline progress storage, all in a Flutter app built for daily use.
capabilities: On-device data persistence for offline reliability
AI-generated guidance tailored to the user
Built for daily, low-friction check-ins

teacherProgress.title: Teacher Progress
teacherProgress.summary: A teacher performance tracking platform, live on Google Play and the App Store.

Exportable, shareable PDF reports

toxelpay.title: Toxel Pay
toxelpay.summary: A finance management app covering expenses, subscriptions, transfers and bills.

qutof.title: Qutof
qutof.summary: A fresh produce e-commerce app with a role-based admin companion, built with Flutter and Firebase.
qutof.overview: Qutof brings fresh fruit and vegetables online — ordering, cart management and delivery tracking in a Flutter app, with a separate role-based admin app running stock and fulfilment behind it.

Firebase-powered real-time order queue

Designed for a cross-border delivery workflow

bakery.overview: A bakery's online storefront, built with React and Node.js — browsing, ordering and delivery tracking wrapped in a warm, product-first design.

Designed to feel like a bakery, not a template

Consistent, professional visual identity

sala.summary: A web platform for sending gifts and connecting people with the people they care about.

instapost.summary: A personal build of a social feed application, built with React.

React front end covering the full social loop

cards.title: Matrix Key Binding
